name: feature-tabs
purpose: The feature walkthrough band of a product page: a left-aligned section title over up to three tabs on one side and the active tab's illustration on the other, closed by a small link under the frame. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'feature-tabs', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box`, `media-tabs`, `illustration` and `mini-button`. The tabs advance on a timer that pauses under the pointer or keyboard focus and never runs under reduced motion; that state is owned by `media-tabs`.
useWhen: To walk through the two or three features behind one claim, one picture at a time, like Functions' Observability.
avoidWhen: For architectures drawn as diagrams across the full width → use `architecture-tabs`.
For a scroll-driven walkthrough of more features → use `feature-scroll`.
related: media-tabs` — the timed tabs this section renders through.
illustration` — the scene each tab shows.
bestPractices: Keep to three tabs; tabs past the limit are not rendered.
Give every tab an `illustrationLabel` saying what its picture shows.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the left section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: The features, in order, at most three; each is `{ title, description, illustration, illustrationLabel? }` where `illustration` is a registry name and `illustrationLabel` its accessible name.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Small link under the frame; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }` where `trailing` adds the chevron. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import FeatureTabs from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-tabs'

  const tabs = [
    {
      title: 'Trace',
      description:
        'The run as a waterfall: each step placed against the invocation it belongs to, nested where it nested.',
      illustration: 'live-debugging',
      illustrationLabel: 'A trace waterfall of one invocation'
    },
    {
      title: 'Logs',
      description:
        'Structured output on the same clock as the trace, filtered by level, searchable in place.',
      illustration: 'traffic-and-cost-bar-chart',
      illustrationLabel: 'Structured logs filtered by level'
    },
    {
      title: 'Request path',
      description:
        'The workload, application, function and connector it travelled, each captioned with the time spent there.',
      illustration: 'distributed-apis',
      illustrationLabel: 'The path a request took through the platform'
    }
  ]

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Open an invocation',
    href: '/product-preview',
    trailing: true
  }
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureTabs
    eyebrow="Observability"
    title="Inspect every run end-to-end"
    description="Every invocation of a function is traced on the platform itself — spans, logs and the path the request took. Nothing to configure, no storage to attach. Pick a document to open it."
    :tabs="tabs"
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
  />
</template>
